department: Department of Atmospheric and Climate Science

deadline.value: Apply by December 1, 2026 for autumn 2027 (autumn only).
deadline.quote: The application deadline for the Atmospheric and Climate Science program for Autumn Quarter 2027 is December 1, 2026.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required and self-reported scores are redacted.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are not required for application to our graduate program. Self-reported GRE scores will not be considered and will be redacted during application review.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The pages do not say whether you need a supervisor first.

funding.value: Everyone is considered for a research assistantship, and most offers include one.
funding.quote: All applicants, regardless of citizenship, are automatically considered for a research assistantship – there are no additional forms required. Most offers of admission are accompanied by an offer of a research assistantship.

entry_route.value: You enter from a bachelor's into the MS track and can apply to the PhD in your third year.
entry_route.quote: All students admitted into the Atmospheric and Climate Science graduate program are admitted initially into the MS program of study with the option of applying to the PhD program in their third year of study.

notes: UW also offers PhDs in Oceanography and Environmental & Forest Sciences, not covered here.
